body.statement:
In Tan's source notation, let \(A_0,A_1,Y,L_0,\overline L_1,\pi_0^*,\pi_1^*,\mathcal E_{L_0},\mathcal E_{\overline L_1},\lambda_0\), and \(\lambda_1\) denote the generic variables, propensities, conditional-expectation operators, and nonnegative sensitivity functions used there. Tan's published equation~(17) defines
\[
\mu^{1,1}_{\mathrm{ICE}}(\lambda_0,\lambda_1)
=E\!\left(\mathcal E_{L_0}\!\left[\mathcal E_{\overline L_1}\!\left\{(\pi_0^*+(1-\pi_0^*)\lambda_0)(\pi_1^*+(1-\pi_1^*)\lambda_1)Y\right\}\right]\right)
\]
and
\[
\mu^{1,1}_{\mathrm{IPW}}(\lambda_0,\lambda_1)
=E\!\left\{A_0A_1\left(1+\frac{1-\pi_0^*}{\pi_0^*}\lambda_0\right)\left(1+\frac{1-\pi_1^*}{\pi_1^*}\lambda_1\right)Y\right\}
\]
for any nonnegative functions \(\lambda_0\) and \(\lambda_1\).

source.locator: Tan, arXiv:2308.15725v1, ssa-0829-2023.tex lines 478--491; published equation (17)
source.verbatim_statement: For any nonnegative functions $\lambda_1 (\overline{L}_1, y)$ and $\lambda_0 (L_0, y)$, we define $\mu^{1,1}_{\mytext{ICE}} (\lambda_0,\lambda_1) = E \left( \mathcal E_{L_0} \left[ \mathcal E_{\overL_1} \left\{ (\pi^*_0 + (1-\pi^*_0) \lambda_0) (\pi^*_1 + (1-\pi^*_1) \lambda_1) Y \right\} \right] \right)$, $\mu^{1,1}_{\mytext{IPW}} (\lambda_0,\lambda_1) = E \left\{ A_0 A_1 \left( 1+ \frac{1-\pi^*_0 } { \pi^*_0 }\lambda_0 \right) \left( 1+ \frac{1-\pi^*_1 } { \pi^*_1 }\lambda_1 \right) Y \right\}$.

attestation.note: Exact excerpt supplied in the round-1 source-fidelity directive from the lawful primary author manuscript, source TeX ssa-0829-2023.tex lines 478--491. The corresponding display is equation (17) in the published Biometrika article.
